search_field_description.title: Words in the build or record title.
search_field_description.name: Words in the build's own name.
search_field_description.subtitle: Words in the line shown under the title.
search_field_description.tag: A showcase tag on the build.
search_field_description.restriction: A component or design restriction the build follows.
search_field_description.type: The build's type, such as flush or seamless.
search_field_description.creator: A credited creator's name or public creator ID.
search_field_description.version: A Minecraft version the build works in.
search_field_description.kind: What the build is: a door, entrance, extender or utility.
search_field_description.criterion: What the record measures, such as fastest or smallest.
search_field_description.version_scope: Whether the record compares builds from every version or only those that work today.
search_field_description.record_state: Whether a record is current or retired. Retired records only appear when asked for.
search_field_description.former_holder: The ID of a build that used to hold the record.
search_field_description.tied: The ID of a build that shares the record.
search_field_description.volume: The number of blocks in the build's bounding box.
search_field_description.door_width: The width of the doorway in blocks.
search_field_description.door_height: The height of the doorway in blocks.
search_field_description.door_depth: The depth of the doorway in blocks.
search_field_description.orientation: How the door is placed, such as door, trapdoor or skydoor.
search_field_description.extender_length: How many blocks the extender reaches.
search_field_description.completion_at: When the creators finished the build.
search_field_description.updated_at: When the build was last changed.
search_field_description.opening_time: Ticks from input until the door is open.
search_field_description.visible_opening_time: Ticks from input until the door looks open.
search_field_description.closing_time: Ticks from input until the door is closed.
search_field_description.visible_closing_time: Ticks from input until the door looks closed.
search_field_description.opening_reset_time: Ticks after opening until the door accepts input again.
search_field_description.closing_reset_time: Ticks after closing until the door accepts input again.
search_field_description.extension_time: Ticks from input until the extender is extended.
search_field_description.retraction_time: Ticks from input until the extender is retracted.
search_field_description.extension_reset_time: Ticks after extending until the extender accepts input again.
search_field_description.retraction_reset_time: Ticks after retracting until the extender accepts input again.
